rules: RESET_HOLD is authoritative. No social publication or new production scheduling is allowed until config/content_strategy.json is explicitly replaced by a new post-reset strategy.

full_reset_hold.rule: All future social publishing remains blocked. Historical published content is retained only for deduplication/audit. No previous schedule or media job may be revived automatically.

current_nonlegacy_category_exception.dog_bartender_carousel: The 13:00 Σκύλος Μπάρμαν — ο παράξενος πελάτης four-card photo-carousel series is current approved content and must never be rejected merely because legacy dog video categories are retired.

cancelled_legacy_rule: Cancelled UUIDs are audit references only and are never gaps to revive. Reuse of underlying media is permitted only by creating a new current-program entry after fresh QA and deduplication when that exact media/content is still valid.

dog_bartender_tiktok_gate.published_success_protection: Never touch or duplicate already Published Facebook/Instagram destinations while repairing TikTok.

narrated_feature_duration_gate.failure_policy: Block before scheduling and expand substantive script/content; never use silence padding or a paid fallback.

deduplication_policy.unknown_write_result: Reconcile by live read before any retry.

history_policy.rule: Git history retains superseded configuration for audit only. Published content is not modified or republished.

final_render_qa_gate.rule: Never create or release a Metricool/social publishing entry merely because a JPEG/WEBP/MP4 exists. Directly inspect the exact final artifact. Every carousel card and video scene must visibly contain correct scene-relevant photographic/photorealistic or approved archival imagery as applicable. Text-only, blank, generic, placeholder, mismatched, repeated or uninspected visuals are a hard failure: keep draft=true and autoPublish=false, repair, and re-run QA.

required_checks: no placeholders, generic mismatches or accidental repeated visuals
burned-in Greek subtitles present and synchronized when required
sources and licenses verified when applicable
platform-specific media format and audio configuration pass
media extension/container alone is never accepted as proof of photographic content
hard_qa_gate.failure_policy: Do not publish, do not substitute a lower-quality fallback, and do not mark ready. Keep the Metricool entry draft=true and autoPublish=false, repair the final visual, directly inspect it, and re-run QA.

topic_deduplication_gate.rule: No current slot may be released until its topic is checked against live Metricool history, repository history and the current queue. A reworded version of a previously used core topic is still a duplicate and must be replaced.
